messages.subject: ledger SPEC ready; brainstorm partial (invariant gate)
messages.body: Mechanism: a stdlib script (skill sc-review-ledger) is the only writer of a per-document ledger; review 1 is the only full find pass, reviews 2 and 3 only answer the script-written plan rows and check this round's hunks, the profile computes blocking, grades are frozen, minor rows cannot be answered, unclaimed reviser edits are reported (reverted with --revert-unclaimed), the script computes the counter, cap and last-line verdict, and one fresh whole-document sweep is reported but never looped; variant /sc:spec-panel-ledger, one-line brief substitution in the three review briefs. Predicted on S1: honest review-3 critical+major headline (loop rows + sweep + out-of-hunk, deduplicated) 5.5 (range 3 to 9) against the bar of 3, so the bar is predicted MISSED; loop-only count 3 (Arm B 3.5); growth after two cycles 26% (bar 44.4% met, Arm B 30%), because I verified that the base proposal's key trace (minor F22 to N5 to N12) is not broken: F22 was an FR-8 finding the profile makes blocking and its edit shares the AC-0.4 row with blocking F10. Biggest risk: apparent convergence by not looking (verify-only lowers the loop count while defects move to the sweep), and the dominant cause, fixes creating new defects, is left untouched; brainstorm status is partial because the invariant gate stayed blocked (9 HIGH items carried into the merge, not re-probed) and Wave 3 used about 3.59M subagent tokens against a 540K estimate without the hard-kill abort.
